name: Calculator
descriptor: Inputs, a formula, one answer. No list, no storage, nothing to remember — the smallest useful app there is.
verify_checks: pattern calculator: no entity, as declared
formula: the parser is emitted and eval is not used
formula: every identifier is a declared input or a known function
pros: nothing to store, so nothing to lose and nothing to back up
instant: one screen, one answer, no save button
the formula is data in the spec, so a new calculator is a new spec, not new code
works from a USB stick with no network, which is when you need it
cons: no history, so a result cannot be revisited tomorrow
one formula per app: a second calculation needs a second app
the parser is deliberately small: no dates, no percentages of a base, no lookups
it cannot explain itself beyond the label and the unit
best_for: one calculation done repeatedly, where a spreadsheet is overkill
avoid_if: the answer depends on records kept over time, or several formulas are needed
